set -e
# the kubelet auto-creates a missing file-subPath as a directory;
# remove any such stale dir from earlier runs before seeding
if [ -e /seed/config.json ] && [ ! -f /seed/config.json ]; then
  rm -rf /seed/config.json
fi
if [ ! -f /seed/config.json ]; then
  if [ -f /seed/data/config.json ]; then
    # migrate from the previous layout where config.json lived under data/
    cp /seed/data/config.json /seed/config.json
  else
    cp /app/defaultConfig.json /seed/config.json
  fi
fi

set -euo pipefail
min_rows="$USAG_BOOTSTRAP_MIN_RAINBOW_ROWS"
[ -n "$min_rows" ] || min_rows=1000000
rainbow_rows="$(psql "$DATABASE_URL" -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM usagnum_hash_lookup" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
[ -n "$rainbow_rows" ] || rainbow_rows=0
if [ "$rainbow_rows" -lt "$min_rows" ]; then
  echo "USAG bootstrap preflight failed: usagnum_hash_lookup has $rainbow_rows rows; need at least $min_rows. Run gdb-scraper-usag-bootstrap first."
  exit 1
fi
exec /app/entrypoint.sh mso

modules:
  http_2xx:
    prober: http
    timeout: 5s
    http:
      valid_http_versions: ["HTTP/1.1", "HTTP/2.0"]
      follow_redirects: true
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  icmp:
    prober: icmp
    timeout: 5s
    icmp:
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  tcp_connect:
    prober: tcp
    timeout: 5s
    tcp:
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  dns_udp:
    prober: dns
    timeout: 5s
    dns:
      query_name: "google.com"
      query_type: "A"
      transport_protocol: udp
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
